title: Full Manifest Cycle
description: Take a shipment from a spreadsheet row all the way to an audited, approved booking without ever leaving the browser: import it, select it, approve it, and confirm the paper trail records every step in order.
successCondition: A test uploads a one-row valid CSV through the Admin console's import dropzone, confirms the Accepted stat tile reads 1 and the new shipment's id appears; without reloading, the same shipment now appears as a checkbox row in the Bulk Actions panel (reload() runs after import); the test checks that row and clicks "Approve selected", confirming the Succeeded stat tile reads 1; finally the Audit log card is confirmed to contain both a "shipment.csv_import" entry and a "shipment.bulk_approve" entry for the acting admin, with the import entry appearing below (older than) the approve entry.
hints: CsvImportPanel's onImported callback triggers the same reload() that populates BulkActionsPanel's shipment list — no manual page refresh needed between steps.
The audit log only records shipment.bulk_approve, not a per-item entry — assert on the single action-level entry, not one per shipment.
